$comment: Agent table for scripts/agent-conformance.ps1. One entry per `bellatrix init --agent` value; ids must equal AgentSelection.Names (ConformanceConfigTests). Headless syntax verified from official docs on 2026-10-27 (URLs per entry) and cross-checked against the installed CLI's --help where installed. {prompt} = the probe prompt, {repo} = the temp repo. `cost` is printed before a run. Adding an agent = adding an entry here (+ the emitter in the CLI).

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.notes: cwd = project (loads .claude/skills, .claude/agents, CLAUDE.md). -p denies tools not allowed. Subagent calls carry parent_tool_use_id. On Windows Claude may prefer its PowerShell tool; a Bash(...) rule may not cover it (unverified).
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
agents.notes: JSON event schema is not documented, so only the reply + trace are used. Reads .github/skills, .claude/skills, .agents/skills; agents from .github/agents.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: Cursor CLI
agents.notes: Binary is `agent` (primary entrypoint since 2026-01-08; `cursor-agent` remains a backward-compatible alias, tried second). Scoped allow lives in .cursor/cli.json; its behavior under -p is not documented.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: Devin CLI (Devin Desktop, formerly Windsurf)
agents.notes: No JSON output; only the reply + trace are used. Print mode fails in an untrusted folder without --respect-workspace-trust false.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: OpenAI Codex CLI

capabilityProbe.outdatedHint: installed codex has no `codex exec --json` (legacy 0.1.x TypeScript CLI); upgrade with `npm i -g @openai/codex`

agents.notes: Shell runs appear as item.type=command_execution. Skills from .agents/skills; custom agents from .codex/agents.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: Gemini CLI (enterprise: Gemini Code Assist)
agents.notes: --allowed-tools is deprecated in favor of the policy engine, whose workspace tier is disabled (a user-level ~/.gemini/policies file would be needed; the harness never writes to the user's home). Unpaid/Google One users were moved to Antigravity CLI on 2026-06-18.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: Google Antigravity CLI
agents.notes: Text output (no --output-format) so the reply is the locator. No scoped allow-list is documented, so the run skips permission prompts; it only ever runs in the harness's throwaway temp repo. No auth-status command is documented: an unauthenticated run shows up as ERROR. Rules from .agents/rules, skills from .agents/skills, subagents from .agents/agents/<name>/agent.md.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: Kiro CLI
agents.notes: Headless auth is KIRO_API_KEY. Text output so the reply is the locator (stream-json is JSONL only). The default agent loads .kiro/steering (always) and AGENTS.md; the BELLATRIX custom agents list the steering file and skills in resources.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.notes: --auto approves permissions that are not explicitly denied (the locator specialists keep edit: deny). Text output so the reply is the locator (--format json emits raw events). Auth depends on the configured provider: no status command is used; an unauthenticated run shows up as ERROR.
agents.cost: Running this agent headlessly may consume paid usage - check the vendor's documentation.
